en: A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a busy urban square with tram tracks, pedestrians, bicycles, and multi‑story brick and stone buildings. In the foreground a colorful illustrated gnome or elf carrying a tray has been added over the photo. The caption at the top identifies the view as Järntorget in Gothenburg, and museum information and an archive code appear along the bottom margin.
